trust_decision.summary: A path derived from the agent workspace (job) name is written into the ssh wrapper script that command-line git executes, so characters the shell interprets run as commands on the agent; the fix decides that a workspace path containing shell metacharacters must not be used as a temp-file location (fall back to the system temp dir), that the known_hosts file is non-sensitive and always goes to the system temp dir, and that any path still interpolated into the wrapper is POSIX-shell quoted.

landing_point.why: It is the only place in the source that names shell expansion as the threat ('Avoid backquote shell expansion') and it is the shared temp-file factory whose result is what an interpolated path is built from; a report about a crafted workspace/job name on an agent leads an engineer here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: GitClient.clone_/fetch_/push/submoduleUpdate/lsRemote -> any helper that calls the package-private createTempFile (createSshKeyFile:2366, createPassphraseFile:2527, createNote:2029, commit:3537)
same public calls, via createUnixGitSSH:2728 / createWindowsGitSSH:2705 -> getVerifyHostKeyOption; only when the global host-key strategy is 'Manually provided keys' (Git.java:139-141)
same as above - escapePath is the shell-quoting primitive used by the three callers of getVerifyHostKeyOption
fix_sites.module_kind: verifier strategy extension, hand-rolled quoting helper (fix.diff:56-72)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The path is only interpolated when the administrator has selected the 'Manually provided keys' host-key strategy: every other strategy returns a constant flag and never sees a path (KnownHostsFileVerifier.java:28, AcceptFirstConnectionVerifier.java:16, NoHostKeyVerifier.java:24), so a solver can call this a configuration-specific neighbouring feature whose odd triple-quote escaping is pre-existing and separately unit-tested rather than part of the workspace-name issue in the report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate Unix job names containing a single quote, spaces or parentheses ('Bob's-job', 'My OWASP (special) case') must still produce a workspace-local temp file, and credential temp files (ssh private key, passphrase, username/password) must keep being created by the same factory; an over-broad fix that routes every path needing shell quoting to the system temp dir, or that refuses those names, moves private keys and passphrases off the workspace and reintroduces the documented JENKINS-22706 class of failures where a system temp path with a space breaks msysgit credential handling.

O6_input_shapes: workspace directory name containing $(...) command substitution (added by the fix at fix.diff:14; tested at fix.diff:106-112)
workspace directory name containing a backquote - already guarded at CliGitAPIImpl.java:2007 and retained
temp path containing a single quote, e.g. 'Bob's-Job' - escapePath now backslash-escapes it (fix.diff:67-69)
temp path containing a space - now wrapped as '"..."' so both the shell and ssh_config see one argument (fix.diff:71)
temp path containing parentheses, e.g. 'paren(1)' - Unix keeps the workspace temp file, Windows falls back to the system dir (fix.diff:118-137, CliGitAPIImpl.java:2001)
path shape with a $(...) in the temp-file prefix rather than the directory (fix.diff:248-261)
Windows vs Unix dispatch on File.pathSeparatorChar == ';' - the Windows branch still returns the raw path (fix.diff:57-64)
percent sign token expansion - pre-existing and unchanged (CliGitAPIImpl.java:1992-1995)

O7_producer.where: src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/gitclient/GitHostKeyVerificationConfiguration.java:15-36 (GlobalConfiguration + PersistentDescriptor, saved to XML on set) resolved and serialized to the agent at src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/gitclient/Git.java:139-144, producing the verifier from verifier/ManuallyProvidedKeyVerificationStrategy.java:33-35

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Extend the Unix metacharacter guard to ;, &&, " and newline (or invert it into an allow-list) instead of adding one more literal
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The method already enumerates offensive characters one at a time ('%' at 1992, backquote at 2007) with a comment per case, so the natural post-CVE hardening is another branch in this same chain.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second escapePath-style helper for a new host-key option (IdentityFile, ProxyCommand, CertificateFile) that copies the hand-rolled quoting instead of reusing unixArgEncodeFileName
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class already owns a private quoting helper rather than calling CliGitAPIImpl.unixArgEncodeFileName:2470-2475, so a maintainer adding another -o option to the returned string would extend this helper in place.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Windows-only option carrying a workspace-derived path in the .bat wrapper, where escapePath returns the path raw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Windows wrapper is generated by the same method pair and its branch of escapePath has no quoting at all on the assumption that the temp file 'can't contain spaces' (ManuallyProvidedKeyVerifier.java:48-51), which stops being true once the known_hosts file moves to the system temp dir.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third generated helper script (askpass/credential-helper variant) that interpolates a workspace temp path with its own escaper rather than unixArgEncodeFileName
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: There are already four generated scripts here (ssh .sh/.bat, askpass .sh/.bat) each writing a different path into the file body, so another script type is a routine addition in this file.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78) via shell metacharacters in a filesystem path interpolated into a generated script

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add $( to the backquote check at CliGitAPIImpl.java:2007 (which is exactly what the new createTempFile test asserts) and stop, leaving the hand-rolled path escaping in ManuallyProvidedKeyVerifier.java:47-53 untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/gitclient/verifier/ManuallyProvidedKeyVerifier.java:57-65 writes the approved host keys to a system temp file that is never deleted on the JGit path - temp-file hygiene, not command injection.

src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/gitclient/CliGitAPIImpl.java:2038,2308-2312,3541 pass workspace temp paths as argv elements (ArgumentListBuilder/ProcStarter), not through a shell, so they are outside this advisory's injection property.
unverified: Repo size in bytes was not measured (no shell in this session); the tree has 15,451 lines of main Java in 61 files and 19,170 lines of test Java in 73 files (~1.6 MB of Java), so tiny_repo was flagged from line/file counts rather than a du figure.
present_in_latest is unknown for every route: 'latest release: none' was supplied and no later tree or network was available, so only the pinned tree and the fix diff could be read.

escapePath's replace("'", "\\'") produces a backslash inside a single-quoted shell word, which is not POSIX quoting (the file's own unixArgEncodeFileName at CliGitAPIImpl.java:2470-2475 uses the correct '\'' form); an apostrophe in the path may yield a wrapper sh cannot parse. Not verified by execution.
Windows behaviour (raw path branch, .bat quoting, system-temp paths with spaces) was judged by reading only; no Windows host was available.
